verses.text: The LORD hates rigged scales. Honest weights make him glad.
Pride shows up and shame follows. Wisdom comes with humility.
Integrity guides people who live uprightly. Crookedness destroys those who betray others.
Money won't help on the day of wrath, but righteousness rescues from death.
Doing what's right keeps a person of integrity on a straight path. The wicked trip over their own wrongdoing.
The upright are rescued by doing what's right. The unfaithful get trapped by their own evil cravings.
When a wicked person dies, their hope dies too. Everything they expected from their power comes to nothing.
A person who does right gets out of trouble, and the wicked take their place.
The godless ruin their neighbors with their words. Knowledge gets the righteous out of danger.
When things go well for people who do right, the city celebrates. When the wicked perish, people shout for joy.
The blessing of upright people lifts up a city. The words of the wicked tear it down.
Looking down on your neighbor shows a lack of wisdom. Someone with understanding knows when to stay quiet.
A gossip spills what was told in confidence. A trustworthy person keeps a secret.
Without wise guidance a nation falls. With plenty of advisers, there's victory.
Guarantee a stranger's debt and you'll pay for it. Refuse to put yourself up as collateral and you'll be secure.
A gracious woman gains honor. Violent men gain riches.
A merciful person does themselves good. A cruel person brings trouble on their own body.
The wicked earn wages that don't deliver. Sow righteousness and the reward is sure.
Anyone who truly does what's right finds life. Anyone who chases evil finds death.
The LORD detests crooked hearts. People whose ways are blameless make him glad.
Make no mistake, evil won't go unpunished. The children of those who do right will be rescued.
A beautiful woman without good judgment is like a gold ring in a pig's snout.
People who do right desire what's good. The wicked can expect wrath.
One person gives freely and gains even more. Another holds back more than they should and ends up poor.
A generous person will have plenty. Give others water and you'll get water too.
People curse someone who hoards grain, but they bless the person who sells it.
Search hard for what's good and you're seeking favor. Go looking for evil and it'll find you.
Trust your wealth and you'll fall. People who do right will thrive like green leaves. 🌿
Bring trouble on your own household and you'll inherit the wind. A fool will serve someone wise at heart.
What the righteous produce is a tree of life. A wise person wins people over.
Look, even those who do right get repaid here on earth. How much more will the wicked and the sinner?
